competitive_landscape: Aremiti operates the commuter ferry on Papeete↔Vaiare; Air Tahiti dominates inter-island air; tour-boat operators (Moorea Reef Discovery, Aqua Polynesia) run the lagoon tour market. Nothing operates an electric / foiling tier, and resort jetties around Tahiti and Moorea are under-served by water mobility today.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the Tahiti–Moorea lagoon-edge resort and tour transfers — ~8–10 nm hops on protected reef water inside the 70 nm all-electric envelope.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: The N35 Shuttle is the right platform for the Papeete↔Vaiare multi-daily commuter lane (12–15 pax + luggage on protected water). Hybrid Quanta-LR is the Society Islands extender — Tahiti↔Raiatea/Tahaa (~115 nm) and Tahiti↔Bora Bora (~150 nm) — with no charging-infrastructure dependency.

precedents.what: Bora Bora built node — luxury island-hop archetype
precedents.why_it_matters: Tahiti–Moorea is the southern anchor of the FP arc; Bora Bora is already built. Together they form the Society Islands spine with a clean Quanta-LR extender between them.

regulatory_note: French Polynesia is a French overseas collectivity. Direction Polynésienne des Affaires Maritimes regulates inter-island shipping; Service de la mobilité Polynésie française oversees public transport. FP has aggressive territorial conservation policies (Tainui Atea Marine Managed Area is one of the world's largest), MARPOL and IMO standards apply via France. Premium charter falls under territorial charter licensing — not Schengen but French civil maritime regime.
seasonality: Year-round operability — French Polynesia's tropical climate is benign on the protected Tahiti-Moorea channel. Peak May–October (austral winter, drier). Wet season November–April brings occasional cyclonic systems but the corridor stays generally workable behind the reef.

summary: Tahiti and Moorea form French Polynesia's economic, demographic and luxury-tourism hub: Papeete is the international gateway and the majority of FP's ~280k residents live on Tahiti, Moorea and the Society Islands. Moorea sits ~9 nm across a protected channel with high-frequency Aremiti car/passenger ferry service (multiple daily, ~30 minutes) plus dense luxury-resort arrivals at the Hilton, Sofitel, InterContinental and Conrad clusters. A textbook protected-water commuter + resort shuttle inside the Pioneer II and N35 Shuttle envelope — the highest-fit FP node and the natural southern anchor for the French-Polynesia arc.
tagline: French Polynesia's commuter + resort spine — a protected 9 nm channel run with multiple daily ferry frequency.
